subject: NimbusWorks walkthrough — compact window & SE overlap
body:
From: Priya Shah <priya@nimbusworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12 09:12 -0700
Subject: NimbusWorks walkthrough request

Hi Marissa / Rishi,

Thanks again for the intro earlier. The exec sponsor (Alex Chen) and our platform team are available Thursday, Apr 15 at 3:00pm PT for a 45-minute walkthrough. Can you confirm Redwood can cover a compact, 45-minute surface-level demo focused on latency/cost controls and rollout options?

If that works, please send an invite and let us know who from the SE team will join.

Best,
Priya
Principal Product Manager
NimbusWorks

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbusworks.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12 10:15 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusWorks walkthrough request

Hi Priya — thanks, that time works from our side.

Rishi, can you confirm SE coverage for Thu 3pm PT? If Rishi is tied up we can have Kim take point on the demo (she's familiar with the latency/cost playbook). I've attached the calendar invite stub and will hold until we confirm SE.

Attachment: calendar-invite-nimbus-2026-04-15.ics (calendar invite stub)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@nimbusworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12 11:40 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusWorks walkthrough request — conflict and options

Hi all,

Quick update — I pulled my calendar when I saw the 3pm PT slot and realized I have a mandatory leadership sync that just moved into that window (execs asked for a short pre-quarter planning alignment). On top of that I depart on a short-repop air travel day Friday morning, so my availability around Thu late afternoon is fragile.

Options I can offer:
- Option A: Move the customer demo to Fri Apr 16, 11:00am PT (45m). I can join async (recording + quick Q&A) but not live for the first 20 minutes because of travel check-in.
- Option B: Keep Thu Apr 15 3pm PT but swap SE lead to Kimberly Park (CC'd). Kim can run the live demo and field the latency/deploy questions — she's led similar sessions with Finch & Aurora and knows our batching/cache recommendations cold.
- Option C: Reschedule to Mon Apr 19 10:00am PT for a full, uninterrupted slot.

I attached a short note with SE coverage options and a link to the mutual action plan so Priya can pick what works best for NimbusWorks.

Attachment: SE_coverage_options.pdf (one-page: swap vs record vs postpone)
Related: https://docs.redwood.ai/maps/NW-2026-047-mutual-action-plan

Sorry for the churn — this is a leadership-preempt and travel combo. If Marissa wants to hand off to Kim for the live block, I'm happy to do the post-demo technical follow-up and answer any deeper latency/quantization questions next week.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0789

Date: 2026-04-13 16:45 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusWorks walkthrough request — final time and owner

Priya, Alex — thanks for being flexible. Per Rishi's note we scheduled a compact live session with Kimberly as the SE lead to avoid travel risk. New meeting: Fri Apr 16 at 11:00am PT (45m).

I've updated the invite and attached the confirmed calendar link. Kimberly will run the walkthrough; Rishi will join immediately after his travel for the Q&A (approx +20m into the session) and will follow up with a technical note on batching/kv-cache recommendations. We'll also record and share the recording and the short one-page SE options doc.

Event link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=nw-demo-20260416
DocuSign (SOW draft): https://docusign.com/s/NW-SOW-DRAFT (for reference)

Attachments: calendar-invite-nimbus-2026-04-15.ics (updated), SE_coverage_options.pdf

Thanks, looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
